rows.judge_reason: Table 1 on page 33 reports projected real GDP growth of 3.1 percent for 2026, the current year of the Article IV consultation.
Table 1 on page 33 and the text on page 2 report the latest preliminary/actual period average consumer price inflation rate of 2.3 percent in 2025.
Table 4 on page 37 lists the latest ECCB policy rate at 3.0 percent in 2025.
Table 5a on page 38 reports commercial banks' nonperforming loans to total gross loans as 8.9 percent for 2025.
Table 1 on page 33 provides the latest printed unemployment rate of 23 percent for 2016 under Social and Demographic Indicators.
The report only provides the regulatory capital ratio (total capital to risk-weighted assets) and does not report the Tier 1 capital ratio.

gdp_growth_forecast_pct.where: Table 1, Real GDP, 2026 projection (same figure in the press release table, p.5, and the outlook text table, p.12)

headline_inflation_rate_pct.where: Table 1, Consumer prices, period average 2025; press release p.2: 'averaging 2.3 percent in 2025'

central_bank_policy_rate_pct.where: Table 4, Interest rates, ECCB policy rate 2025; Dominica uses the EC dollar under the ECCB's quasi-currency board (p.91)

non_performing_loan_ratio.where: Table 5a, commercial banks, Nonperforming loans to total gross loans 2025 (credit unions: 15.05, Table 5b)

unemployment_rate_pct.where: Table 1, social indicators: 'Unemployment rate (2016) 23'. The only unemployment figure in the report and ten years old, so a null with that reason is also acceptable

tier_1_capital_ratio.where: Not reported. Table 5a gives the regulatory capital ratio, total capital over risk-weighted assets (21.0 in 2025); Tier 1 appears only as a denominator (pp.42, 46)
